description: Phone loudspeaker capture test set across volume levels and acoustic noise environments

sentences.text: Starlink satellites operate in low Earth orbit to provide broadband internet.
Reusable rockets significantly reduce the cost of access to orbit.
Artificial intelligence systems require high performance compute clusters.
The battery pack provides electrical power to the dual electric motors.
Solar energy generation has increased substantially over the past decade.
Optical space lasers enable high speed inter satellite communication.
Autonomous vehicles rely on vision neural networks and real time inference.
Global supply chains depend on efficient maritime freight transportation.
Quantum computing explores novel cryptographic algorithms and materials science.
Renewable power grids balance variable wind generation with energy storage.

low.description: Phone speaker at ~30% volume (~52 dBA at 15cm)

medium.description: Phone speaker at ~65% volume (~64 dBA at 15cm)

high.description: Phone speaker at 100% volume (~76 dBA at 15cm)

quiet.description: Quiet living room or private office with minimal ambient sound

fan.description: Room with ceiling fan or air conditioner running (pink/brown noise 100-500 Hz)

traffic.description: City apartment with open window near road traffic (low rumble, intermittent tires)
